title: Project on Tourism and Travel Management

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to design tourism programs and evaluate their effectiveness.
Students will develop observational skills and apply theoretical knowledge to practical situations.
Students will learn to work effectively in teams and collaborate with different groups.
Students will gain experience working independently and managing their own projects.
Students will improve their negotiation skills in various scenarios.
Students will enhance their communication skills through interactions with peers and professionals.
Students will develop leadership qualities and learn to manage teams effectively.
Students will learn to identify and solve problems that arise during project implementation.
Students will be introduced to the basics of writing reports based on field observations.
Students will understand the importance of professional responsibility and ethical conduct.
